dedupe_keys.name: commerce commission annual telecommunications monitoring reports and industry questionnaire time series 2006 to 2025 new zealand

description: Each year New Zealand's Commerce Commission publishes a monitoring report on competition in, and the performance and development of, telecommunications in New Zealand, based on an industry questionnaire completed by providers. Reports are listed for 2022 (published June 2023), 2023 (August 2024), 2024 (June 2025, 17 MB) and 2025 (29 June 2026, 4.7 MB). The questionnaire results for 2024 and 2025 are published as Excel workbooks, and a time series workbook of questionnaire results from 2006 to 2025 (about 0.16 MB, March 2026) gives long-run figures on subscriptions, revenues, coverage and technologies such as fibre, mobile and fixed wireless. The Commission also publishes topic papers on specific market developments. Coverage: New Zealand. Format and access: PDF reports and XLSX data, free. Caveats: provider-reported data; definitions change over the series; content of the time series was not opened in this session. Simulation uses: long subscription and traffic series for demand growth, and technology mix for exposure and capacity models. Related records: the Commerce Commission connectivity map gives spatial coverage, and Measuring Broadband New Zealand gives measured speeds.
